verdict.rationale: CSC documents a centralized CSCNavigator dashboard for entity information across all jurisdictions, with filed evidence auto-linked to entities, a real-time compliance calendar, and SOP documents delivered as searchable PDFs, which covers the single-account entity, registration and document management core. Team access is only implied: the evidence shows email reminders to unlimited users and designated SOP contacts, not shared multi-user logins or permissions. missing for 10: explicit multi-user team access and role permissions on one account, explicit confirmation that received SOP documents are stored in the same dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access

citations.quote: A centralized view of entity information across all jurisdictions in one secure dashboard
CSC uploads filed evidence to CSCNavigatorSM, automatically linking the documents to your entities for easy review and 24x7 access
CSC updates the good standing Compliance Calendar® in CSCNavigator in real time
We deliver all SOP documents in high-quality, searchable PDF format
The CSC good standing calendar can automatically send email reminders to unlimited users.
We'll receive, scan, and deliver your SOP according to your routing preferences and designated contacts.
